description_en: Obtains the analysis results of a specific Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) directory of a cluster. The depth of the directory is not greater than five
description_zh: 通过EMR Doctor获取集群HDFS特定目录数据分析结果，目录不超过5级
kebab_example: aliyun emr get-doctor-hdfs-directory --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --date-time 2023-01-01 --dir-path /tmp/test --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDoctorHDFSDirectory

parameters.help_en: Specify the date in the ISO 8601 standard. For example, 2023-01-01 represents January 1, 2023
parameters.help_zh: 其日期和时间信息以 ISO 8601 格式表示， 例如：2023年1月1日为 2023-01-01
parameters.name: date_time

parameters.help_en: The directory name. The depth of the directory is not greater than five
parameters.help_zh: 目录名称。目录不超过5级
parameters.name: dir_path

Data.description_en: The analysis results of the HDFS directory

Group.description_en: The group to which the directory belongs
